app.title: Ticket Bot Dashboard
app.askAdmin: Ask a server administrator to grant you access.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.avgHandlingTimeHint: From opening a ticket to closing it.
stats.teamHint: Staff members ranked by tickets closed.

myTickets.title: My tickets
myTickets.cardHint: Every ticket you opened. You can reply to open ones right here, your reply is posted in the Discord channel under your name.
myTickets.empty: You have not opened any tickets yet.

ticket.heading: Ticket #{id}
ticket.closeDialogHint: The channel is archived, a transcript is generated and the creator is notified. This can take a few seconds.
ticket.conversationStored: Stored transcript of the closed ticket.
ticket.transcriptSaved: This ticket is closed. Its full conversation was saved as a transcript.
ticket.noTranscript: This ticket is closed and no transcript was stored for it.
ticket.replyAsSelf: Reply, this is posted in Discord under your name.
ticket.lockedHint: This ticket is locked, no replies possible.
ticket.closedHint: This ticket is closed. Reopen it to reply.

bot.title: Bot control
bot.updateHint: git pull + npm install, this can take a couple of minutes.
bot.consoleHint: Live output of the bot process.

config.title: Configuration
config.saved: Saved. Restart the bot for the changes to take effect.
config.unsavedFile: You have unsaved changes. Switch file and discard them?
config.unsavedView: You have unsaved changes. Switch view and discard them?
config.blockingErrors: {count} problem(s) must be fixed before saving:
config.envNotice: The .env file is restricted to the server owner. It holds the bot token, session secret and OAuth secret, so staff with "Edit configuration" can edit config.jsonc, snippets and the locale files, but can never see or edit this file.
config.lookupsHint: Click a name to copy its ID.
config.lookupsFailed: Could not load (is the bot in the server?).

access.title: Permissions
access.overrideNotice: A user entry overrides that person's role entries entirely, so you can take a permission away from one person that their role grants. The server owner always has every permission and cannot be locked out.
access.grantHint: Give a role or a single user access to this dashboard.
access.configScopeNote: "View/Edit configuration" covers config.jsonc, snippets and the locale files. The .env file (bot token and secrets) stays restricted to the server owner and is never shown to staff, even with these permissions. The dashboard's own accent colour and favicon are separate: they are governed by "View/Edit dashboard settings".
access.activeToggle: Active (turn off to suspend this entry without deleting it)
access.whoHint: The server owner is always an admin and is not listed here.
access.whoEmpty: Nobody else has dashboard access yet.
access.auditHint: Every change made through the dashboard.

settings.title: Dashboard settings
settings.introShared: Branding for this dashboard. It applies to everyone who uses it.
settings.introCanEdit: Changes take effect immediately for every user.
settings.introReadOnly: You can view the current branding but need the "Edit dashboard settings" permission to change it.
settings.accentHint: Buttons, highlights, the active menu item and focus rings. Previews live.
settings.accentReset: Accent colour reset to the default.
settings.faviconHint: The small icon in the browser tab. PNG or ICO, up to 256 KB.
